name: @argszero/dsh-image-pipeline-doctor
description: Checks at boot that the host's image decode path works, so a broken native image module is named once instead of surfacing as a session error on the first pasted screenshot. It submits one 1x1 PNG through the public `ctx.attachments.validateImage()` call, which reaches the decoder before the pass-through branch, and logs exactly one line naming the decoder and the real cause when that fails. A healthy install says nothing, a mounted-but-idle host says nothing, and no path out of the plugin throws or blocks a boot: it reads and reports, never repairs, never writes an attachment and never retries.
